verdict.rationale: Open WebUI's Computer docs describe a per-chat tool approval mode. In the default "auto" mode, no command runs and nothing changes on disk until the user approves, and pending approvals appear as tool cards with Allow / Deny buttons. That covers the approval-prompt core of the story, but the evidence never shows command allowlists, and the approval mode is set per chat rather than per action. Missing for 10: command allowlists, per-action opt-in elevation, detail on what the other approval modes are, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a self-hoster, dangerous actions require my explicit approval — command allowlists, approval prompts, and elevated modes that are opt-in per action

citations.quote: Every chat has a tool approval mode, set from the + menu in the chat input
auto is the everyday setting: the AI can explore freely, but nothing changes on disk and no command runs until you say so.
